caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular rug or carpet design with a decorative floral motif. The central area of the rug is a light pinkish-beige color, featuring a large red rose with green leaves in the middle. Surrounding the central rose are smaller flowers and buds in various shades of red, blue, white, and pink, with green leaves and stems branching out in different directions. Along the border of the rug, there is a dark brown or olive-green frame, which contains a repeating arrangement of floral patterns in colors such as red, light blue, cream, white, and dark blue. The floral elements on the border include large blossoms, leafy stems, and stylized, curved foliage. The overall composition is symmetrical, with similar floral motifs mirrored along the central axis, and the decorative elements are rendered with soft, painterly brushstrokes. The background outside the rug's edges is a solid, light beige color.
title: Hooked Rug
